experiment: N18ALIGN: N=18 L=1 sign-aligned and larger-cluster transfer confirmatory, frozen v4 center-4 Nov3 vs QAOA p=1
closed_l3_levers: PR99/101/102/115 exhausted; PR119 unsigned-mean UNSTABLE at N=18; this stream is the mechanistic confirmatory follow-up, not another unsigned-mean copy at other N

hypothesis.one_sentence: At N=18 L=1, a train-only s1-sign-aligned mean of 8 Nov3 vectors transfers to 8 unread test instances with sign-aligned-mean Nov3 minus unsigned shared-mean QAOA mean ΔE CI entirely <0.
hypothesis.not: Not L2/L3. Not a GR patch. Not an adoption. Not a new gate from PR119's test set. Does not replace per-instance SPSA. Unsigned mean remains the secondary PR119-protocol replication, not the primary.

split_documented_before_fits.rule: Stage A fits train only. Freeze unsigned mean/median, sign-aligned mean, and larger-cluster mean from train vectors before any test SPSA or transfer energy. Primary label uses sign-aligned-mean Nov3 vs unsigned-mean QAOA; unsigned-mean Nov3 vs unsigned-mean QAOA is secondary PR119 replication; larger-cluster vs unsigned QAOA is secondary. Aggregators not chosen on test.

larger_cluster.aggregator: mean of that cluster's raw vectors

transfer_eval.charge: every energy call; no query-free prefix

selection: FT energy selection on independent fits. F post hoc, never selects. Transfer evals use the frozen vector as-is (no SPSA on test for those cells).

contrasts.1_train: independently optimized Nov3 − QAOA on train 10680-87
contrasts.2_primary: test sign-aligned-mean Nov3 − unsigned shared-mean QAOA
contrasts.2b_larger_cluster_secondary: test larger-cluster-mean Nov3 − unsigned shared-mean QAOA
contrasts.3_test_ceiling: independently optimized Nov3 − QAOA on test 10688-95
contrasts.4_transfer_gap: test sign-aligned-mean Nov3 vs independently optimized Nov3 on test (descriptive; not a gate that Nov3 must beat itself)

report.primary_label: TRANSFER_MEAN_NEGATIVE_CI iff test sign-aligned-mean Nov3 minus unsigned shared-mean QAOA bootstrap 95% CI (4000, rng 3334) of mean ΔE is entirely <0 on n=8; else UNSTABLE
report.concentration: Report train unsigned mean/std/range of packed coordinates with the n=8 caveat, plus n_pos/n_neg of s1 and n_flipped under the s1-only map
report.gr: Do not patch GR. No final. No L2+. No L3. No adoption.
